description: This file defines the class StackFrameSnapshot, which serves as a base class for different types of stack frames in a debugging or crash analysis context, including Java, native, and kernel frames. It includes constants for frame types, attributes to hold frame data, constructors for different initialization scenarios, and a clone method.

classes.name: StackFrameSnapshot
classes.description: Base class representing a stack frame with type indicators and associated text.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates and returns a copy of this stack frame snapshot.
